description: This file defines the front-end route component for displaying and managing a list of boards, including creating, renaming, deleting, reordering, and selecting boards, with real-time updates and embedded Kanban board display.

methods.name: initBoards
methods.description: Fetches the list of boards from the API, sorts them, and sets the first as selected if none is selected.

methods.name: handleCreateBoard
methods.description: Creates a new board using input fields and updates the boards list.

methods.name: startRename
methods.description: Initiates renaming process for a specific board.

methods.name: handleRenameBoard
methods.description: Updates the board's title on the server and locally.

methods.name: handleDeleteBoard
methods.description: Deletes a specified board after confirmation and updates the list and selection.

methods.name: selectBoard
methods.description: Sets a board as the currently selected one.

methods.name: handleDnd
methods.description: Handles the drag-and-drop reordering of boards, updating the order on the server.

methods.name: reloadSelectedBoard
methods.description: Refetches the data for the currently selected board to refresh its contents.
